A friendly note, this evening
A crowded season is easier with a plan

Travelers should confirm pet papers, carrier fit, and check-in readiness before arrival.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Aurelia Skyways supports calm, careful handling for companion animals at every skyport. Please keep carriers closed, labeled, and easy to lift, and let the ground team move them between services without delay. <<FACT F027>> Bring any required food, water, and cleaning supplies in a tidy bag, and keep pet stays brief at the counter.

For smooth acceptance, travelers should present pets in secure carriers and follow crew directions without argument. <<FACT F012>> If a pet needs extra care, tell the desk at once so the proper steps can begin.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding for clear guidance and final checks.
